scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hello stranger.
I wish I could
offer you help
on your adventures...
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
你好，陌生人。
真希望能在你的冒險中幫上忙...

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
We can't even begin
to fathom the number
of markets and people
out there in this wide,
wide world of ours.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
在這個廣闊的世界裡，有多少市場、多少人，我們根本無法想像。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I believe it's time
for my final lecture.
I'll discuss the definitive
skill of the Merchant: ^871F78Vending^000000. Please listen carefully.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
我想是時候進行最後一課了。
我將講解商人的終極技能：^871F78露天商店^000000。
請仔細聽好。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
How much have
you learned
about Vending?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼...
你關於露天商店學到了多少？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Now to talk about
^871F78Push Cart^000000. First off, you need to know Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can even learn the Push Cart skill.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
接下來談談^871F78手推車^000000。
首先，你需要先學會5級負重量上升，才能學習手推車技能。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So, have you
learned Push Cart up
to Level 4 like I asked?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼，你按照我的要求把手推車練到4級了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, ready to
learn already,
are you? Alright,
let me tell you
about ^871F78Over Charge^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，已經準備好要學了嗎？
好的，讓我告訴你關於^871F78高價賣出^000000的事。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
How is it going
with learning that
^871F78Over Charge^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼...
學習^871F78高價賣出^000000技能進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Let me see those
Red Potions. Now,
how much did you
pay for these...?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
讓我看看那些紅色藥水。
那麼，你花多少錢買到的這些...？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Let me see those
Red Potions. Ah, it seems you researched the market and bought the cheapest ones! Great work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
讓我看看那些紅色藥水。啊，看來你研究了市場行情，買了最便宜的！
幹得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hmm...
You'll find some NPCs
selling 10 Red Potions
in Prontera. Your task
is to buy the potions
for the cheapest price.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
嗯...
你會在普隆德拉找到一些NPC出售10瓶紅色藥水。
你的任務是以最低的價格買到藥水。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright...
I've given it some thought and I've come up with a little challenge for you. Bring me... 10 Red Potions!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的...
我思考了一下，為你準備了一個小挑戰。
給我帶來...10瓶紅色藥水！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you're back!
Now, I was going
to tell you about
the Discount skill, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，你回來了！
我本來想告訴你關於低價買進技能，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So, how is it going with learning the Discount skill? Like I always say, if you can't make a bargain, you can't be a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼，學習低價買進技能進展如何？
就像我常說的，如果你不會砍價，你就不能成為商人！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've come back to learn more. Let's see, what was I going to tell you about... Right, Mammonite!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，你回來學更多了。
讓我想想，我本來想告訴你什麼...對了，金錢攻擊！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So...
Did you learn the
Increase Weight Limit
skill up to Level 4
like I asked?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼...
你按照我的要求把負重量上升練到4級了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You've just started out as a Merchant, haven't you? How would you like to learn the fundamentals of business from an experienced colleague?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
你剛開始做商人，對吧？
你想不想向一位經驗豐富的同事學習商業基礎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
However, what I have to teach would only benefit Merchants. Trading and money making are my areas of expertise. If you have any Merchant friends, send them to me.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
不過，我要教的內容只對商人有好處。
交易和賺錢是我的專長。
如果你有商人朋友，把他們介紹給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Technically, yes, you're a Merchant, but I know an expert when I see one. You've been through the Merchant life before, I can tell!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
從技術上講，是的，你是商人，但我一眼就能看出行家。
你以前經歷過商人的生活，我能看出來！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
All of them are possible customers and business partners. Of course, it'll be up to you to meet them.
If you can be sincerely kind to everyone that you meet, you'll
have no problem.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
他們所有人都是潛在的顧客和商業夥伴。
當然，去結識他們取決於你。
如果你能真誠地善待你遇到的每個人，你就不會有問題。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The Vending skill is an active skill which allows you to open your own shop where you stand. Vending allows you to do real business with other people.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
露天商店是一個主動技能，允許你在站立的位置開設自己的店鋪。通過露天商店，你可以與其他玩家進行真實的交易。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
However, you can only vend items that are stored in your PushCart,
so you'll need one of those. The maximum price you can set for
each item is 99,990,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
不過，你只能出售存放在手推車裡的物品，所以你需要一輛手推車。每件物品的最高定價為99,990,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Basically, you've got to learn the Push Cart skill first before you can learn the Vending skill.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
基本上，你必須先學會手推車技能，才能學會露天商店技能。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The higher the level of the Vending skill, the more items you can vend at one time. Vending is mastered at Skill Level 10.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
露天商店技能等級越高，一次能出售的物品數量就越多。該技能在10級時達到精通。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Level 1 Vending allows you
to vend a total of 3 items at one time. Each time you level up the Vending skill, the total number of items you can vend will
increase by one.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
1級露天商店允許你一次出售3件物品。每提升一級露天商店技能，可出售的物品總數就會增加1件。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But it looks like I just put my foot in my mouth. I'm sorry, I didn't notice that you already mastered the Vending skill...
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哎呀，看來我多嘴了。抱歉，我沒注意到你已經精通露天商店技能了...

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
For your final assignment, I will ask you to learn the Vending skill up to Skill Level 4. Of course, once you do, I'll give you a little reward. I'll be waiting, so do your best~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
作為最後的任務，我會要求你將露天商店技能練到4級。當然，完成後我會給你一點獎勵。我會等著你的，加油哦~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But I see that you must already know that, huh? Well, seeing as you're so clever, I think you've earned this little prize~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
不過我看你似乎已經知道了，對吧？既然你這麼聰明，我想你值得這份小禮物~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You're such an
excellent student!
Please, take this
little reward for
all your efforts~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
你真是個好學生！
請收下這份小獎勵，以表彰你的努力~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Hmm...
Haven't learned Level 4 Vending yet, huh? Just keep in mind that being able to vend things is one
of the defining characteristics of being a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
嗯...
還沒學會4級露天商店，是嗎？
請記住，能夠出售物品是商人這一職業的重要特徵之一！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Excellent!
You've taught yourself well. Here, you've earned this little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
太棒了！
你自學得很好。給你，這是你應得的小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh, I see that you're very serious about being a Merchant. I'm proud that you've managed to master this skill! Here, you deserve this reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哦，看來你對成為商人非常認真。我很自豪你能掌握這項技能！給你，你值得這份獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, now you have mastered the fundamentals of the Merchant class. Just keep practicing the basic principles, like researching the market for item prices, and you should be fine.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，現在你已經掌握了商人職業的基礎。只要繼續練習基本原則，比如研究市場價格，你就沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Although everything we do is for money, never forget customer needs and always sell your products at a suitably fair price. Otherwise, no one may buy your goods!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
雖然我們所做的一切都是為了錢，但永遠不要忘記顧客的需求，並以合理的價格出售商品。否則，可能沒人會買你的東西！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, there's nothing more I can teach you for now. Go out into the world and make your mark as a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好了，目前我沒什麼更多可以教你的了。去外面的世界闖蕩吧，在商人的道路上留下你的印記。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
And feel free to
visit me whenever
the mood strikes you.
Good luck to you~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
如果你想我了，隨時歡迎來找我。
祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Push Cart can be mastered at
Skill Level 10. This skill allows you to carry a Push Cart with you. You can carry a maximum of 100 different kinds of items that weigh less than 8,000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
手推車技能在10級時達到精通。該技能允許你攜帶手推車。你可以攜帶最多100種重量小於8,000的不同物品。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
As you can see, this skill is an advanced form of the Increase Weight Limit skill. You can procure a PushCart from most Kafra Ladies for a certain fee.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
如你所見，這項技能是負重量上升技能的進階形式。你可以向大多數卡普拉 職員支付一定費用來租用手推車。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Once you have rented a Cart, you can hold on to it so long as you don't take it off. The disadvantage to using a PushCart is that your movement speed is reduced to
almost half! Horrible, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
一旦租用了手推車，只要你不卸下它，就可以一直持有。使用手推車的不便之處在於，你的移動速度會降低到幾乎一半！很糟糕，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Fortunately, when you increase
the level of the Push Cart skill, your movement speed will slowly be restored. With Push Cart Level 10, a PushCart won't slow you
down at all!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
幸運的是，當你提升手推車技能等級時，你的移動速度會逐漸恢復。在手推車技能達到10級時，手推車完全不會拖慢你的速度！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
For now, why don't
you learn the Push Cart
skill up to Level 4? Once
you do that, I can go on to
my next lecture.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
那麼，先試著把“手推車”技能練到4級吧？
等你練好了，我就可以繼續講下一課了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, and I see that you've been focusing on learning Push Cart. Although you might still have a problem with your movement
speed, it shouldn't be a big deal.
Well done~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，看來你一直在專心練習“手推車”技能。
雖然你的移動速度可能還是有點慢，但這不是什麼大問題。
做得很好~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Wonderful! You've already
mastered the Push Cart skill.
You truly deserve a little bit of a reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
太棒了！你已經掌握了“手推車”技能。
你確實值得獲得一點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Still not there, huh?
Well, remember that you need
Level 5 Increase Weight Limit before you can learn the Push
Cart skill. I hope that helps.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
還沒練好嗎？
記住，你需要先將“負重量上升”技能練到5級，才能學習“手推車”技能。
希望這能幫到你。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well done~
You've been a very
cooperative student.
You deserve a little
reward for your effort~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
做得很好~
你是一個非常配合的學生。
為了你的努力，你值得獲得一點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Excellent!
You've actually went above and beyond mastered the Push Cart skill. Great work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
太出色了！
你不僅掌握了“手推車”技能，還超額完成了任務。幹得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Next time, I'll talk about the skill that sets Merchants apart from all the other classes: ^871F78Vending^000000. So don't miss it!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
下次，我會講解讓商人與其他職業區分開來的技能：^871F78露天商店^000000。千萬不要錯過哦！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Like Discount, Over Charge is a Passive skill that can be mastered at Skill Level 10. Therefore, it doesn't require SP to use it.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
和“低價買進”一樣，“高價賣出”是一項被動技能，在技能等級10時達到精通。因此，使用它不需要消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Over Charge allows you to sell items to NPC shops for more Zeny. The higher your Over Charge Skill Level, the more Zeny you'll receive for items sold to NPCs.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
“高價賣出”可以讓你以更高的Zeny價格將物品賣給NPC商店。你的“高價賣出”技能等級越高，賣給NPC的物品獲得的Zeny就越多。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Personally, I think you should learn this skill for sure! For your next assignment, learn Over Charge up to Level 4. It shouldn't be too difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
我個人認為你一定要學習這項技能！你的下一個任務是：將“高價賣出”練到4級。這應該不會太難。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've already learned Level 4 Over Charge. Perfect! Let me give you a little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，你已經練到4級“高價賣出”了。完美！讓我給你一點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Amazing! You've already mastered the Over Charge skill! You must have wanted this reward badly~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
太厲害了！你已經掌握了“高價賣出”技能！你一定很想要這個獎勵吧~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Once you do that,
we can talk about
more advanced stuff.
Do your best~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
等你完成這個任務，我們就可以討論更高階的內容了。
加油~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Mm? You haven't
learned Over Charge
up to Skill Level 4 yet?
There's no rush, but I won't be able to lecture on anything until you finish this little task.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
嗯？你還沒把“高價賣出”練到4級嗎？
不用著急，但在你完成這個小任務之前，我無法繼續講課。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Nice work!
I can tell that
you've done just
as I asked. Please,
take this little reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
幹得好！
可以看出你完全按照我的要求做了。請收下這點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Whoa...
You actually
mastered Over Charge?
Most impressive! You deserve a small reward for your work!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哇...
你真的掌握了“高價賣出”？
太令人印象深刻了！為了你的努力，你值得獲得一點小獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Next time, I'll discuss the
Push Cart skill. Be ready for this lecture, as Push Cart is one of the more important skills for a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
下次，我會講解“手推車”技能。請為這堂課做好準備，因為“手推車”是商人最重要的技能之一。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah...!
It looks like...
You were scammed!
D-don't worry, though,
I won't tell anybody.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊...！
看起來...你被騙了！
別擔心，我不會告訴任何人的。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh well, it happens even to the best of us. Just think of this as an invaluable learning experience.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
算了，這種事連最厲害的人也會遇到。就把這次經歷當作一次寶貴的學習經驗吧。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Now, why don't you go to Prontera and try to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC for the cheapest price again?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
現在，去普隆德拉試試，以最低的價格從NPC那裡買10瓶紅色藥水吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time, we'll talk about the skill that you can learn after knowing how to Discount:
^871F78Over Charge^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的，下次，我們來談談在學會“低價買進”之後可以學習的技能：
^871F78高價賣出^000000。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, you'll probably want to research the market price for Red Potions. And always, be careful of scammers and cheats!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
首先，你最好研究一下紅色藥水的市場價格。而且，一定要小心騙子和作弊者！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
It's not too hard, but the stipulation I'm adding is that you've got to find the merchant selling Red Potions for the cheapest price.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
這並不難，但我加了一個條件：你必須找到以最低價格出售紅色藥水的商人。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So first, you'll need to research the market price for Red Potions. Also, be careful of scammers! If the price is too good to be true, it usually is.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
所以首先，你需要研究紅色藥水的市場價格。另外，小心騙子！如果價格好得難以置信，那多半就是假的。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ha ha ha, let me make your goal a bit less confusing. You will need to buy 10 Red Potions from an NPC in Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哈哈，讓我把你的目標說得更清楚一點。你需要在普隆德拉從NPC那裡購買10瓶紅色藥水。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Prontera's a bit far from here, isn't it? I'll just use this Kafra Warp-- Mahnsoo has a bunch for
some reason --to send you there right now. Get ready...!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
普隆德拉離這裡有點遠，不是嗎？我就用這個卡普拉傳送——Mahnsoo不知為何有一堆——現在就把你送過去。準備好...！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The ^871F78Discount^000000 skill allows you to buy items at lower prices from NPC shops. It is a ^871F78Passive Skill^000000 which is always in effect and does not consume SP.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
^871F78低價買進^000000技能可以讓你以更低的價格從NPC商店購買物品。這是一個^871F78被動技能^000000，始終生效且不消耗SP。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The Discount skill is
mastered at ^871F78Level 10^000000. The higher the skill level, the less you have to pay for items at NPC shops.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
“低價買進”技能在^871F78等級10^000000時達到精通。技能等級越高，你在NPC商店購買物品時支付的費用就越少。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright! Now, in order to become closer towards becoming a true Merchant, I want you to learn the Discount skill up to Level 4.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的！現在，為了讓你更接近成為一名真正的商人，我希望你將“低價買進”技能提升到4級。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oooh, good work.
I see that you've
raised your Discount
to Level 4 already.
Here, take this
small reward~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哦，幹得好。
我看到你已經將“低價買進”提升到4級了。
拿著，這是給你的小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
難以置信！
你真的精通了“低價買進”技能！你真是個好學生。你值得獲得一點獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
It'd be nicer if you could
master it, but you might be more interested in devoting your time to other skills.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
如果你能精通它當然更好，但你可能更想把時間花在研究其他技能上。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Still, you can't ignore the fact that bargaining is an essential skill for a Merchant! Come back to me when you're ready~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
不過，你不能忽視這樣一個事實：討價還價是商人必備的技能！準備好後再來找我~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Not yet, huh?
Well, you should be able to reach that goal soon. After all, it's one of the basics of being a Merchant!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
還沒準備好嗎？
嗯，你應該很快就能達到那個目標。畢竟，這是成為商人的基本功之一！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, you've learned
how to use the Discount skill
well enough. Good, here's a little reward for your hard work~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，看來你已經足夠熟練地使用“低價買進”技能了。很好，這是對你辛勤工作的一點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Incredible!
You've actually mastered the Discount skill! You're such a great student. You deserve a bit of a reward!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
難以置信！
你真的精通了“低價買進”技能！你真是個好學生。你值得獲得一點獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, my next lesson will hopefully offer you a bit more of a challenge. Come back when you think you're ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的，我的下一課希望能給你一點挑戰。等你覺得自己準備好了再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
^871F78Mammonite^000000 is a skill that lets you greatly damage targets with Zeny. Money really is power!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
^871F78金錢攻擊^000000是一個可以用Zeny對目標造成巨大傷害的技能。金錢真的是力量！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
The upside is that it inflicts great damage and only uses a little SP. However, the downside is that it will also consume your Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
它的優點是造成巨大傷害且只消耗少量SP。然而，缺點是它也會消耗你的Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
So if you use this skill too often, you might end up bankrupt! So be really careful. Also, as the Skill Level for Mammonite increases, so does the attack strength and Zeny consumption.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
所以如果你太頻繁地使用這個技能，你可能會破產！所以要非常小心。另外，隨著“金錢攻擊”技能等級的提高，攻擊強度和Zeny消耗也會增加。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah, I see that you've already tried this skill. How much money have you wasted using Mammonite? Not too much, I hope.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊，我看到你已經嘗試過這個技能了。你在使用“金錢攻擊”時浪費了多少錢？希望不是太多。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的。現在我覺得我們可以討論^871F78低價買進^000000技能了。等你想聽我詳細介紹時再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, since you're still green, I feel awfully sorry if you've wasted Zeny. Why don't you take this as compensation?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
嗯，既然你還是新手，如果你浪費了Zeny，我會感到很抱歉的。不如收下這個作為補償吧？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Okay. Now I think we're ready for me to discuss the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill. Come back when you'd like me to tell you more about it, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好的。現在我覺得我們可以討論^871F78低價買進^000000技能了。等你想聽我詳細介紹時再來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Ah. I can tell that you have. Not bad! By now you should be able to learn the ^871F78Discount^000000 skill, but I'll teach you about that later.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
啊。看得出來你已經掌握了。不錯！到現在你應該能學習^871F78低價買進^000000技能了，不過我會稍後再教你。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
No? That's fine.
But I can't teach you
much more if you can't grasp these simple basics, so hurry and learn those skills, okay?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
沒有？沒關係。
但如果你連這些基礎都掌握不了，我就很難教你更多了，所以快點學會那些技能，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
還有幾個你可以立刻學習的基本技能，我先講講這些。彆著急~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
首先，是^871F78物品鑑定^000000技能。學會這個能力後，你就可以^871F78鑑定未知物品^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
這個技能的作用和^871F78放大鏡^000000完全一樣，所以你不需要再花錢買放大鏡了。而且，這個技能在^871F781級^000000時就已經精通了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
從你的眼神里我看得出，你已經學會鑑定物品了。哈哈，雖然掌握這項知識本身就是一種獎勵，但我還是再給你點額外的東西吧！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好了，下次我會講“金錢攻擊”技能。現在讓我從這枯燥的講課中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text:
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation: 好了，下次我會講“金錢攻擊”技能。現在讓我從這枯燥的講課中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: I'll make it on my own!
scripts.translation: 我自己來！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
{0}
But first things first!
You better learn the
^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
{0}
不過，凡事要從頭來！
你最好先學會^871F78負重量上升^000000技能！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
You can't really be a Merchant if you can't even carry around goods to sell. As you increase the level of this skill, you can carry around more items.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
如果你連用來出售的商品都帶不了，怎麼能算是商人呢。隨著這個技能等級的提高，你可以攜帶更多的物品。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Why don't you upgrade your
Increase Weight Limit skill up to Level 4? After that, we can talk more about becoming a true Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
不如你把“負重量上升”技能升到4級？之後，我們可以再談談如何成為一名真正的商人。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Great...!
Ah, and I see that you've learned the ^871F78Increase Weight Limit^000000 skill to at least Level 4. You're a real go-getter, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
很好...！
啊，我看到你已經把^871F78負重量上升^000000技能學到了至少4級。你真是個行動派，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Since your Increase Weight
Limit skill level is high enough, you must be able to see a new skill in your Skill Window: ^871F78Discount^000000!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
既然你的“負重量上升”技能等級足夠高，你應該能在技能視窗看到一個新技能：^871F78低價買進^000000！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
But we'll discuss the Discount skill later. There are a few other basic skills which you can learn right away that I'll talk about first. Let's not rush~
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
但我們稍後再討論“低價買進”技能。還有幾個你可以立刻學習的基本技能，我先講講這些。彆著急~

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
First, there's the ^871F78Item Appraisal^000000 skill. This ability, once you've learned it, allows you to ^871F78identify unknown items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
首先，是^871F78物品鑑定^000000技能。學會這個能力後，你就可以^871F78鑑定未知物品^000000了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
This skill works exactly like a ^871F78Magnifier^000000, so you won't have to spend any Zeny on them. Also, this skill is mastered at ^871F78Level 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
這個技能的作用和^871F78放大鏡^000000完全一樣，所以你不需要再花錢買放大鏡了。而且，這個技能在^871F781級^000000時就已經精通了。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
I see in your eyes that you've already learned to appraise items. Haha, although having that knowledge is reward in itself, let me give you something extra!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
從你的眼神里我看得出，你已經學會鑑定物品了。哈哈，雖然掌握這項知識本身就是一種獎勵，但我還是再給你點額外的東西吧！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous study.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好了，下次我會講“金錢攻擊”技能。現在讓我從這枯燥的學習中休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Alright, next time
I'll talk about the Mammonite skill. For now, let me take a little bit of a break from all of this arduous lecture. ^666666*Whew!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
好了，下次我會講“金錢攻擊”技能。現在讓我從這枯燥的講課中休息一下。^666666*呼！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Oh...
And I'll tell you
more about the Discount
skill later. I always manage
to forget about that!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
哦...
我會稍後再告訴你更多關於“低價買進”技能的事。我總是會忘記那件事！

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
On your own?
Hahaha, that's the spirit!
But still, the advice I'm giving is free. It couldn't hurt to give what I say a little bit of thought.
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
靠你自己？
哈哈，有這股勁頭就好！
不過，我給出的建議是免費的。稍微聽聽也無妨。

scripts.text:
[Guarnien]
Well, if you ever change your mind, stop by and talk to me anytime. And as a Merchant, you should know that free advice is the best!
scripts.translation:
[瓜爾涅恩]
如果你改變主意了，隨時來找我聊聊。而且作為商人，你應該知道，免費的建議才是最棒的！

scripts.text: [Sagle]
scripts.translation: [薩格爾]

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
就在嘴邊，但我就是想不起來...

scripts.text:
It's on the tip
of my tongue, but
I can't quite remember...
scripts.translation: 就在嘴邊，但我就是想不起來...

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
You know, the name of the company that has all those beautiful ladies working for it. Ka... Ka-something. Anyway, I hear they're concerned about their growing competition.
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
你知道的，就是那家有很多漂亮女士工作的公司。卡...卡什麼的。總之，我聽說他們很擔心日益激烈的競爭。

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
It's none of my business, but it's good to know what's going on in
the world, particularly if it'll affect the markets.
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
這不是我的事，但瞭解世界上的動態總是好的，特別是如果它會影響到市場的話。

scripts.text:
Hello, hello~
Why don't you buy
some Red Potions?
They're essential for travel, and these Red Potions are the best for newer adventurers~
scripts.translation:
你好，你好~
要不要買些紅色藥水？
它們是旅行必備品，而且這些紅色藥水最適合新手冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
I will sell you 10 Red Potions for ^871F78{0} zeny^000000. You'd better get them now while they're still here!
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
我要以^871F78{0} Zeny^000000的價格賣給你10瓶紅色藥水。趁它們還在的時候趕緊買吧！

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Excellent!
You certainly have an eye for bargains. Here you go, 10 Red Potions fresh from the... Potioner...
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
太棒了！
你確實很有眼光。給你，10瓶新鮮的...來自...藥劑師的...紅色藥水。

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Whoa, hold on!
You can't afford
these potions...
Please come back
when you have enough
Zeny, alright?
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
哇，等一下！
你買不起這些藥水...
等你有足夠的Zeny再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Whoa, hold on!
There's no way you carry all of this! Why don't you put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage before coming back?
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
哇，等一下！
你不可能攜帶這麼多東西！為什麼不在回來之前把一些東西放進卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:
[Sagle]
Alright...
But don't
complain if
these potions
are sold out!
scripts.translation:
[薩格爾]
好吧...
但如果這些藥水賣光了，可別抱怨哦！

scripts.text: [Kellion]
scripts.translation: [凱利恩]

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
最近，我聽說王室發生了一些事情。

scripts.text:
Recently, I hear that something
has happened to the royal family.
scripts.translation: 最近，我聽說王室發生了一些事情。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
It's probably not even a reliable rumor, but I've heard that members of the royal family have been dying from some unknown cause.
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
這可能只是不可靠的謠言，但我聽說王室成員因某種未知原因相繼去世。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Huh.
Now that's some morbid news!
Well, hopefully, there's no truth to it whatsoever. None at all...
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
哈。
這真是令人毛骨悚然的新聞！
希望這完全不是真的。一點都不...

scripts.text:
I'm selling sets of
10 Red Potions for {0} Zeny.
Would you like some?
scripts.translation:
我正在以{0} Zeny的價格出售10瓶裝的紅色藥水。
你要買一些嗎？

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Good choice~
Thank you for
using my shop.
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
好選擇~
感謝光臨我的店鋪。

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Ooops!
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I've got to stay in business somehow, you know?
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
哎呀！
抱歉，你的Zeny不夠。我也得想辦法維持生意，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
...Huh?
You better put some of your stuff in Kafra Storage, you can't carry much else!
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
...咦？
你最好把一些東西存進卡普拉倉庫，你沒法再攜帶更多東西了！

scripts.text:
[Kellion]
Well, I'm sorry
to hear that. But
I guess I'll see
you later.
scripts.translation:
[凱利恩]
聽到這個我很難過。
不過我想我們下次再見吧。

scripts.text: [Aigie]
scripts.translation: [艾吉]

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
確實，金錢不是萬能的。我相信還有其他東西對於幸福來說也很重要。

scripts.text: It's true that money isn't everything. I'm sure other things are important to have in order to be happy.
scripts.translation: 確實，金錢不是萬能的。我相信還有其他東西對於幸福來說也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
However, money can be much more dependable than some people I know. You can rely on money more than anything else in this world.
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
然而，金錢比我認識的一些人更可靠。在這個世界上，你可以比依賴任何東西都更依賴金錢。

scripts.text:
Welcome to my shop.
I'm just a young girl who's a victim of circumstance, forced to sell potions on the street for dirt cheap prices.
scripts.translation:
歡迎光臨我的小店。
我只是一個身不由己的年輕女孩，被迫在街頭以極低的價格出售藥水。

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Would you like
to buy 10 Red Potions
for {0} Zeny, kind adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
親愛的冒險者，您願意以{0} Zeny的價格購買10瓶紅色藥水嗎？

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Thank you so much.
Now I can finally
afford food again...
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
非常感謝。
現在我終於能買得起食物了...

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Wait, wait!
I am sorry, but you don't have enough money. Would you please get some more Zeny before coming back?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
等等，等等！
抱歉，您的錢不夠。請您多準備一些Zeny再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
Wait, wait!
You can't possibly carry any more items. Why don't you put your things in Kafra Storage first?
scripts.translation:
[艾吉]
等等，等等！
您不可能攜帶更多物品了。為什麼不先把您的東西存進卡普拉倉庫呢？

scripts.text:
[Aigie]
I understand.
But I hope you
see that I'm offering
